claude_proposed_widenings.name: alter_object_shape
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stone Shape permanently reshapes a stone object into an arbitrary form. The existing Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no variant for object-alteration. The v4 atom inventory includes alter_item_kind and create_object, but neither is exposed as an Effect variant in types.ts. A new Effect variant is needed to represent: 'permanently transform an object of a given material/size constraint into a caster-specified shape, instantaneously.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: object_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stone Shape targets a stone object, not a creature. The current Attachment variants (self, target, area, mark) are all creature- or point-oriented. An object-targeted attachment variant is needed to represent 'a stone object you touch'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller...
